statements.text:
Your constitutional right to privacy does NOT disappear because technology or artificial intelligence advances.

I urge every one of my House colleagues to support my PRIVACY Act to restore the Fourth Amendment protections guaranteed by the United States Constitution. https://t.co/CPsg8vbGtz

Increasing oversight and reform of Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) systems like Flock is critical to combating the growing surveillance state.

As AI advances, these systems are becoming far more than license plate readers—expanding the ability to track and surveil Americans.

Your privacy is not a sacrifice for safety—it is a right protected by the United States Constitution.

🚨Rep. Keith Self: ”These cameras are well beyond an automated license plate reader today. AI has made them so capable that they are now capable of facial recognition, of seeing what you’re doing inside your car. So it’s well beyond the license plate reader…that’s the problem. Technology has moved these beyond just looking at the back of a car."
https://t.co/hCFkZ1DdnX

Rep. Keith Self: “AI has supercharged the surveillance state, trampling our God-given right to be secure in our persons, houses, papers, and effects. These cameras are no longer just license-plate readers looking for vehicles of interest…” https://t.co/JQpFd5Yvsy

Thank you, @GregAbbott_TX! 
The pushback against AI surveillance systems is a bipartisan issue at every level of government—local, state, and federal. 
When Americans are adamant about protecting their privacy and constitutional rights, lawmakers and elected officials should listen.
https://t.co/C10gBuG8lr

Automated License Plate Readers (ALPRs) like Flock cameras—supercharged by AI—are a threat to our Fourth Amendment rights.

My PRIVACY Act would require the federal government to obtain a warrant before accessing these systems, limit data retention, and prohibit federal funds from being used to purchase them.

The illusion of safety cannot come at the expense of liberty!

Technology should serve mankind, not replace it.

AI is advancing rapidly. If we fail to defend our God-given rights and constitutional liberties, we risk surrendering them in the name of progress.

America is the world’s oldest living republic. We have a duty to preserve the liberty we inherited.
